items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: he came by the house, and asked my mother if I could join the St. Agnes Band as a drummer, so here I was, 11 years old, playing in the St. Agnes Marching Band.

ctx.x: No, Bella. Bella. That's the West Indian name for 'brother'. Instead of saying brother, they say 'bella'.
That's great, really -- Bella Roberts, eh?
